edits.before: You actually have the edge at level 1 since your early trade with Q/AA is stronger before Orianna's ball combo comes fully online — look to punish her if she over-extends for CS. From level 2 onward though, her ball-assisted poke (W-E-Q) and shield start controlling the wave, and this becomes her lane to press through levels 3-5. Play around her ball placement: if it's parked near you, expect a poke combo, so reposition rather than standing still. Her range and shield uptime make prolonged trades a loss once her combo is online.
edits.after: You have the edge at level 1: your Q reaches 1075 against Command: Attack's 815, the ball has to travel to arrive, and her rank-1 Q is 7s to your 9s but hits for far less — punish any step-up for CS. From level 2 her Q is 6s and the ball combo comes together, so levels 2-3 are hers to press. Play around ball placement: parked near you means the poke combo is loaded, so move rather than stand. Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield with armour and magic resist attached, which is what makes prolonged trades a loss.

edits.before: Level 6 matters enormously here because Shockwave is one of the best pick/teamfight tools in the game, and getting caught in it with your team is a common way to lose the game outright. Chronobreak gives you a way to dodge the pull with clever positioning or survive it and burst her down for over-extending. Keep tracking her ball position on the minimap — a ball parked away from her means she can't threaten Shockwave range as easily. Look for windows when her ball is out of position to punish her directly.
edits.after: Level 6 matters enormously because Command: Shockwave pulls everything within 410 of the ball toward it, and the ball is wherever she last sent it — so the threat is a location, not a radius around her. Chronobreak is 110s to her 110s, which means every pull she spends can be answered by a rewind of yours. Keep the ball on your minimap: parked away from her, she cannot threaten the pull and cannot shield herself with Command: Protect at the same time. Those are the windows to go.

notes: Six of seven chart rows were split across layers: full phases[].side read 'Skill' throughout while content win[] already matched the packet levelChart (Ekko/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ekko x3). Packet suspectName confirmed as a real defect and fixed: wants.foe[1] said 'Land Shockwave' where the ability is Command: Shockwave. The two facts that were missing and now carry the page are the 410 pull range measured from the ball rather than from Orianna, and Command: Protect granting armour and magic resist on top of the shield. Not verified and therefore not written: whether Ekko's Q or W projectiles interact with the ball at all, and whether Command: Shockwave's displacement can pull Ekko during Chronobreak's untargetable frames.
